question: How often are the Winter Olympic games held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Every four years.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Winter Olympic games:-**

 
 
• These are held every four years.
 
• The first Winter Olympic Games were held in 1924 in Chamonix, France.
 
• The last Winter Olympic Games were held in 2018 in Pyeongchang, South Korea.
 
• The next Winter Olympic Games are scheduled to be held in 2022 in Beijing, China.
 
• The Winter Olympic Games feature sports such as skiing, snowboarding, ice hockey, and figure skating.
